services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Our 10,000 foot skydive is the most basic of our skydiving experiences. It’s a small taste of freefall; an appetizer of skydiving experiences if you will. This budget friendly option price matches standard skydives at other centers but delivers an ocean view skydive experience over paradise. Experience short freefall thrills with breathtaking views of the Monterey Bay coastline. A 10,000-foot first skydive offers everything you’d expect: jumping from a perfectly good airplane, freefall, parachute flight, and all the incredible, rollercoaster ride of emotions that come with a first skydive experience. services.name: tandem jump
services.desc: Even though average skydiving California prices are around $280, there are many different offers, packages, and skydiving opportunities which affect the price. The price of tandem skydiving includes gear, plane and instructor fees, video and photography services, and so on. A lot of different factors means that the price will vary rather often. However, there are certain average prices that you can expect so that you don’t overpay for your adrenaline-filled experience. Skydiving isn’t standardized and a lot of companies offer different services like: # of tandems per flight, true altitude at mean sea level, views, freefall time, experience, safety and facilities meaning that costs can vary.
